_meta.note: Pre-recording gate for the Sep 7 demo video. Harden expected_behaviors before evals day; a failing eval blocks the recording.
_meta.gate: run against the deployed app before recording

questions.question: Which days this week are good for surfing near the Gold Coast?
expected_behaviors: agent calls find_spots / rank_spots_this_week for the Gold Coast region
answer names specific days, backed by scores from scoring.py (no model-invented numbers)
forecast charts are rendered for surfaced data

questions.question: I'm a beginner — which breaks near the Gold Coast should I try this week?
expected_behaviors: skill filter (beginner) is applied to the ranking
returned spots are plausible beginner breaks for the region

questions.question: What time should I surf Snapper Rocks today?
expected_behaviors: agent calls get_forecast + score_week and reasons over hourly scores
answer gives a time window (best hours today) with wind/swell justification

questions.question: Tell me about Margaret Bay — what swell and wind does it like?
expected_behaviors: agent calls get_spot_knowledge and quotes the knowledge base (ideal_swell, ideal_wind, ideal_tide)
tide is described qualitatively only (no invented tide curves)

questions.question: Best beach for an intermediate surfer near Byron Bay this weekend?
expected_behaviors: ranking restricted to the Byron Bay region with skill=intermediate
weekend hours only are considered

questions.question: How windy is it going to be at Bondi tomorrow morning?
expected_behaviors: wind comes from the forecast data (wind_speed_10m/wind_direction_10m), not model guesses
answer includes wind strength and direction with an on/offshore interpretation for the break

questions.question: Is Bells Beach worth a 2-hour drive on Saturday?
expected_behaviors: score for Saturday hours at Bells is computed deterministically and cited
a clear go/no-go recommendation with reasoning

questions.question: Show me the wave height forecast for Kirra for the next 3 days.
expected_behaviors: interactive hourly wave-height chart is rendered (not just text)
numbers match the Open-Meteo Marine fetch (agent never fabricates values)

questions.question: Where can I find a quiet weekday dawn patrol in Victoria?
expected_behaviors: spot search constrained to Victoria region
answer balances scores with knowledge-base character (crowds, skill suitability)

questions.question: Which is better this week: Noosa or Snapper Rocks?
expected_behaviors: both spots scored over the same week and compared with cited numbers
one clear winner with the deciding factors explained
